title: Lissajous figures from two oscillators
hook: Two oscillators at right angles, one at frequency 3 and one at b. Count where the curve touches the square and you have read off their ratio.
alt: A looping curve inside a square, made of interlocking lobes. A bright point runs along it with a fading tail, while two small dots slide along the bottom and left edges, showing the horizontal and vertical oscillations that combine into the curve.
author: @wasm.curious

presets.label: 3 : 2, the classic figure
presets.note: Three lobes across, two up and down: the curve touches the left and right sides three times and the top and bottom twice.

presets.label: b = a, one oscillator
presets.note: Equal frequencies with a quarter-period phase give a circle: the phase portrait of a single harmonic oscillator.

presets.label: Collapse to a curve
presets.note: With δ = 0 the curve traces x = sin 3u against y = sin u, a polynomial graph x = 3y − 4y³ traced back and forth.

presets.label: Nearly 3 : 3
presets.note: A slightly detuned ratio: the circle slowly shears through ellipses. The curve only closes after 20 turns.
